desc: Display top PostgreSQL tables by total size and index size

args.name: -c
args.value: SELECT relname AS table_name, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) AS total_size, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(relid)) AS data_size, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid) - pg_relation_size(relid)) AS index_size FROM pg_catalog.pg_statio_user_tables ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC LIMIT 20;
